# @recursica/adapter-angular-material

> Reusable Angular components for Recursica applications based on Angular Material 20+.

This adapter converts Recursica design tokens into Angular Material-specific theming and components.

## Usage Guidelines

- Relies on the `@angular/material`/`@angular/cdk` peer dependencies (`^20.2.14`).
- When building UI in consumer applications, prioritize using components exported by this package to adhere to the Recursica design system.
- No `@recursica/adapter-common` dependency — see `ARCHITECTURE.md` and `docs/ADAPTER_INTEGRATION_REPORT.md` Crosscutting Finding A.

## Reference Documentation

- [USAGE](USAGE.md): Detailed usage instructions, import rules, and layout/token conventions.
- [OVERSTYLING](OVERSTYLING.md): The `overStyled` escape hatch — this adapter's Angular-native mechanism.
- [SETUP](SETUP.md): Installation and integration steps, including Angular Material's required Sass theming setup.
- [ARCHITECTURE](ARCHITECTURE.md): Package architecture and dependencies.
- [README](README.md)

## Components

Components marked ✅ below are real implementations — everything else is a
`🚧` in-development stub
(see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and
[docs/ADAPTER_INTEGRATION_REPORT.md](docs/ADAPTER_INTEGRATION_REPORT.md) §9
for the build order). No component in this adapter has a per-component
`USAGE.md` yet (a known gap — see `CONTRIBUTING.md`), so entries below link
to each component's implementation folder (which does have an
`IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md`) rather than a `USAGE.md` that doesn't exist yet;
update these links to point at `USAGE.md` as each one is written.
